seoTitle: Which HIMYM Character Are You? How I Met Your Mother Test (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the How I Met Your Mother test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Ted, Marshall, Lily, Robin or Barney — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the hopeless romantic still waiting for 'the one', the big-hearted best friend, or the one who's about to suit up and make tonight legendary? Answer 10 questions about how you really handle love, friends and nights out, and find out which HIMYM character you are.

characters.name: Ted Mosby
characters.title: The Hopeless Romantic
characters.summary: Idealistic, thoughtful and always looking for 'the one'. You believe in fate, big gestures and doing things properly.
description: Like Ted, you're a romantic. He once stole a blue French horn from a restaurant for a woman he'd just met — and he'd do it again.
You care about the details. Ted's an architect (and later a professor), and he has opinions on everything from buildings to the correct use of words.
You overthink your love life, but that's because it matters to you. You're waiting for something real.
characters.flaw: You can be a little pretentious — and you correct people more than you should.
characters.signature: A blue French horn and a very long story.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every date into a ten-year plan

characters.name: Marshall Eriksen
characters.title: The Big-Hearted Best Friend
characters.summary: Warm, loyal and a total softie. You believe in people, love hard and will always be the first to celebrate your friends.
description: Like Marshall, you're a gentle giant. He's from Minnesota, full of small-town kindness, and he loves his friends with his whole chest.
You've got ideals. Marshall went to law school wanting to protect the environment, and he eventually became a judge.
You're a big kid at heart. Road trips, snacks, conspiracy theories and holding onto a very long-running slap bet.
characters.flaw: You're so trusting and sentimental that you get your heart broken easily.
characters.signature: A road trip snack, a hug and a slap bet he'll never forget.
characters.clashReason: they're too sincere to handle your jokes

characters.name: Lily Aldrin
characters.title: The Sweet Schemer
characters.summary: Kind, creative and secretly running everyone's lives. You know everyone's business — and you've usually got a plan.
description: Like Lily, you look sweet. You are sweet — she's a kindergarten teacher and an artist — but you're also sneakier than anyone realises.
You meddle, lovingly. Lily gets involved in everyone's relationships and always thinks she knows best (she often does).
You're fierce about the people you love, and nobody gets past you if they hurt your friends.
characters.flaw: You meddle in other people's lives, and you can't keep a secret.
characters.signature: A paintbrush, a cocktail and a very knowing look.
characters.clashReason: they'd meddle in your love life

characters.name: Robin Scherbatsky
characters.title: The Independent Career Woman
characters.summary: Tough, ambitious and fiercely independent. You don't do mushy — and you won't let anyone else define your life.
description: Like Robin, you're driven. She's a Canadian news reporter who worked her way up to anchor, and her career always comes first.
You're tough on the outside. Scotch, cigars, a love of guns and hockey, and a firm "no" to anything that feels too sentimental.
But you've got a past you'd rather people didn't dig up — Robin Sparkles, anyone? — and a softer side you show only to a few.
characters.flaw: You push people away the moment things feel too serious.
characters.signature: A glass of scotch, a news desk and an 80s music video she'd rather you never saw.
characters.clashReason: they'd run from anything that looks like commitment

characters.name: Barney Stinson
characters.title: The Legendary Showman
characters.summary: Confident, over-the-top and determined to make every night legendary. Underneath the suit, there's more heart than you'd think.
description: Like Barney, you live for the moment. Every night is an opportunity, every plan is a play, and every story ends with "legendary".
You've got rules. Barney wrote the Bro Code and has a Playbook full of schemes, and he never, ever misses a chance to suit up.
But behind the show, you care deeply about your friends — and you grow more than anyone expects.
characters.flaw: You hide real feelings behind the act, and your schemes go way too far.
characters.signature: A perfectly tailored suit and a very loud "Suit up!"
characters.clashReason: they'd never take anything seriously — especially love

options.text: You're looking for 'the one'. Every single time
You'd rather have one great love that lasts forever
Complicated. Your career comes first
It's a game — and you always win

questions.text: Your friend is dating someone terrible. You...

options.text: Quietly work behind the scenes to break them up
Tell them straight
Have a kind, honest heart-to-heart with them
Introduce them to someone better. Tonight

questions.text: A rainy Sunday at home. You...

options.text: Watch a documentary and text your friends the best facts
Play board games and get far too into it
Hockey on TV. Nobody talks during the game
Online shopping for things you definitely can't afford

questions.text: You pick up a new hobby. It's...

options.text: Magic tricks. You've been practising in the mirror
Cooking a family recipe until it tastes exactly like home
A night class. You'll probably end up teaching it
Target shooting. And you're very good

questions.text: You're getting dressed for a night out. You wear...

options.text: Something sharp and tailored. Always
Tweed. Something with character
Whatever's comfy — and a little goofy
A cute outfit you definitely couldn't afford

questions.text: A friend tells you a secret. You...

options.text: Promise not to tell, then tell your partner within the hour
Swear you'll keep it — then joke about it at the worst moment
Say nothing. You've got secrets of your own
Keep it — then tell it as a long story years later

questions.text: It's a normal night at your local bar with your friends. You're...

options.text: Telling a very long story
Plotting to make it a night nobody will ever forget
Sitting with your partner, finishing each other's sentences
Scotch in hand, pretending you're not having the best time

questions.text: Your best friend is getting married. You...

options.text: Give a speech so sincere the whole room tears up
Plan half of it without being asked
Throw the most outrageous bachelor party of all time
Show up looking amazing and avoid the bouquet

questions.text: You meet someone amazing — but they want kids, and you really don't. Or the other way round. You...

options.text: End it. You won't change who you are
Stay, and hope one of you changes your mind
Talk it through for as long as it takes
Move on. There are plenty of others out there

questions.text: Your two best friends break up, and both of them want you on their side. You...

options.text: Stay neutral — and secretly scheme to get them back together
Try to get each of them to see the other's side
Keep out of it until it blows over
Take them both out for a wild night to forget it all
